text:
I still can't confirm which desktop patch introduced the Tiki Totem. The team note says the Tiki items came with the later-1.3 Pirate Invasion update, but my search results point the other way: they list Tiki Armor as introduced in Desktop 1.2, and one guide places Pirate Invasion in 1.2 ([Tiki wiki](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki), [Desktop version history](https://terraria.wiki.gg/hu/wiki/Desktop_version_history)). Treat the note as unverified; the Tiki Totem's own wiki page or the 1.2 patch notes would settle it.

CONFIDENCE: 15
